items.topic: No server-side click deduplication
items.statement: Every click is sent to Salesforce as its own record with no server-side deduplication. Salesforce rolls clicks up to the same sign-up so reps see the relevant one, which captures players who click, drop off, and click again later. Strahinja first assumed dedup was WagerTech's job, then agreed.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Retention of rep slug identifiers The team will continue using existing rep slugs as unique identifiers for now rather than creating a new rep ID system. [Decisions]; and 'Kobi Kunasekaran recommended moving to a unique identifier system for reps ... The team agreed to prioritize this to avoid future synchronization issues' [Details]
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Emily Vandenberg: let's make Okay, let's make sure we're passing the slug and like using it right now and then we'll get back to you / Emily Vandenberg: we'll get back to you on the rep ID thing
gemini_disagreements.why: Gemini contradicts itself: Decisions implies a rep ID system was rejected, Details says the team agreed to prioritize rep IDs. The transcript only says use the slug for now; whether to adopt rep IDs is pending WagerTech's answer.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: New deal records will now originate in Salesforce to eliminate mapping ambiguity. [Summary]; 'Kobi Kunasekaran and Emily Vandenberg reaching a consensus that, moving forward, new deals should originate in Salesforce' [Details]

gemini_disagreements.why: Hardened: Emily said this is where she would like to get to but WagerTech still has to settle deal management ownership internally. No decision was made; the interim decision is to send deal makeup.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Market and country ID system implementation The team will implement an ID system for market, country, and state fields in the API to improve integration reliability and avoid data mapping errors. [Decisions]
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So I'm thinking we do the same thing here too uh where we have some sort of ID system um that you will send over ... / Jay: Yep, that sounds good. So, right now, right now it's Canada, US. There's no way to differentiate. Is that what you're
